title: Learning Who Disagrees: Demographic Importance Weighting for Modeling Annotator Distributions with DiADEM

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the influence of annotator race on subjective safety and offensiveness judgments by learning per-demographic importance weights in the DiADEM model.
Evaluating how annotator age drives disagreement in content moderation by calculating learned demographic importance weights on the DICES and VOICED datasets.
Measuring the effect of annotator gender on labeling variance in safety and political offense datasets using a demographic-aware neural architecture.
Modeling the impact of annotator political affiliation on subjective offense judgments using learned demographic importance weights on the VOICED dataset.
Assessing the influence of annotator education level on annotation disagreement through learned demographic weighting mechanisms.
Evaluating the role of annotator locale in shaping conversational safety judgments by incorporating locale as a weighted demographic axis in the DICES dataset.
